source: Ordinary WAsmC constructs a record holding u64, adds zero repeatedly, and compares against 5; inputs include 0, 1, 5, 6, 2^32+5, 2^63 and u64::MAX.
candidate_70_default: Both compiler APIs and Wasmi/Wasmtime passed all seven inputs.
old_inference_control: The same 70-term test also passed with the old depth-limited type-constraint function and iterative binary projection. This case does not prove the new inference changed observable behavior.
candidate_150_default: Test process SIGABRT from stack overflow; original output retained.
candidate_150_stack32: Both APIs and both engines passed seven values at RUST_MIN_STACK=33554432.
label_correction: Inherited diagnostic print says 70 declarations/160 calls; the actual tests have one record and seven input values.
limitations: Experiment does not fix default-stack failure or prove arbitrary type-constraint semantics. No Source admission or formal release.
